mapper.select: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(dc.cnt, 0) AS driverCount FROM tb_admin a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT admin_idx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_driver GROUP BY admin_idx ) dc ON dc.admin_idx = a.admin_idx WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
SELECT d.*, a.admin_name, c.car_number FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_admin a ON d.admin_idx = a.admin_idx LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx WHERE driver_id = #{driverId}
